song.title: You Don't Mess Around with Jim (level edit)

audio.tempoMap: one tempo point per beat (live band, no click); beat i starts at the sum of the previous beats' 60/bpm, i.e. exactly the per-beat grid

overlayCalibration.note: at stem gain 1.0 each overlay sits this far under the record (gated LUFS over the choruses); each stem is true-peak limited to -1 dBTP. Original + overlays can exceed 0 dBFS: put a limiter/compressor on the game's music bus or play the original at about -3 dB

sections.name: intro
sections.label: Intro: band only (drums, bass, acoustic guitars on E)

sections.name: verse1
sections.label: Verse: vocal melody; 8 bars E then A7/B7 (second half is stop-time: the bass lays out)

sections.name: prechorus1
sections.label: Pre-chorus: 2 bars E, bass walk-up E-F#-G# into the chorus

sections.name: chorus1
sections.label: Chorus: A7 E7 A7 E7 A7 A7 B7(walkdown) E; hook A = bars 7-8

sections.name: tag1
sections.label: Tag: hook B (the post-chorus tag hook)

sections.name: turnaround1
sections.label: Turnaround: 2 bars B7, piano B-octave stabs on every beat, bass walk-up to E

stops.note: the record fades under the final hit

splices.note: song bar 33 b3 -> song bar 62 b3 (identical B7 turnaround bar), 24 ms equal-power crossfade ending 14 ms before the beat

kick.description: kick drum hits detected in the recording (exact hit time; beat is fractional). pos = on | and | trip

tom.description: tom hits off the quarter grid (fills)

fills.description: half-bars with >= 3 off-grid drum hits: fills. accents = strongest hits

bass.description: bass notes from the recording: pitch (MIDI, from pYIN), durBeats, vel

bassWalks.description: the song's signature bass figures (walk-ups, walkdowns, climbs) from the transcription, each note snapped to the detected bass onset (detected=true) where there is one

sustains.description: held vocal notes >= ~1 beat (pitch = sung MIDI note; +12 for a lead-guitar octave)

vocalPhrases.description: vocal phrase spans (start/end), timing only: no words

melody.description: vocal melody as notes (transcription; MIDI at sounding pitch)

hooks.description: hook moments: hookA (title line), hookB (tag), line1, versePeak

bassOut.description: stop-time: runs where the bass lays out (the verses' second halves)

energy.description: one entry per bar: mixDb, per-stem dB, drum hit count, intensity 0..1

cue.description: landmarks (section starts, the breakdown, the last chorus, the fade)

shouts.description: OVERLAY: HIT accents in the vocal gaps (our reward stem, stems/..../shouts.ogg; iteration 9b: were gang HEY!/HUP!s, `word` names the slot: HEY = the big hit, HUP = a jab); t = the hit's attack

stops.description: beats where the whole band drops out

splices.description: EDIT: where the edit jumps (crossfade centred on t)

tokenMelody.description: what a collected token sings (tools/music/original/tokens.py): pitch = token MIDI (the vocal two octaves up); mode double | measured (the singer agrees within agreeCents) | harmony (a chord tone a third above: the singer bends or can't be measured); sung = the transcribed note, measured = pYIN

piano.description: the record's own piano hits (demucs piano stem onsets; vel 0..1): the bar-pianist goon plays these
